title: Free US$1.01 (~A$1.40) Cashback for Search & Click-through at Trivago (1 Transaction Per Day Per Member) @ TopCashback US
body:

[Brick50] Not even going to mention the fact that people who did it last time got banned?
[Craze] Always worth checking comments! For all the hassle, I'll just stick with the AU account.
[puzzles2] Yup that was me, support got back to me asking for a photo of ID so I just left it. That being said it seems like some people didn't get banned so guess you can just try it as there's not much to lose other than your time.
[illumination] Yea I haven't been banned. Been clicking most days since the previous deal was posted - including during the in between period when it was no longer $1.01 and it was just $0.25
[Slo20] No ban for me either. Nor my partner who I referred.
[Riqodex] Great another round! There's still $7 left from last time that haven't been paid out yet, hopefully this will speed it up a bit 😅
[theg00s3] I've been doing this daily for the past month now (it was 1.01, and then dropped to 25c) and my account is chugging along fine
[henry21pc] Beware these people are a scam. I did bookings for Klook via their website. Has about $250 credits in my account and suddenly they closed my account accusing all kind of fraudulent use. I haven’t even login to my account since I made the bookings.
Now can’t login, support no response. My suggestion, Cash out immediately
[Herbs] Heard you the first time on the TCB TGG offer. Rep replied, I get the impression you might have done a dodgy.
[timhn] I remember that I can cash out within 2 weeks when started doing this. But now the cash out not enabled for me even my transactions are more than a month ago.
[crackman] Has anyone had success with topcashback UK Trivago?
[Herbs] Tried, initially it worked but recently it seems like you actually have to make a purchase so I'm not bothering there anymore.
